answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 8442 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to use utensils such as forks, knives, spoons etc. to eat? Question: Is it permissible to use utensils such as forks, knives, spoons etc. to eat? Answer ID: 8442 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1873/1752=D/1429) One can use the things mentioned in the question when needed. But, it is prohibited to use them as fashion and avoid eating with fingers. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
